summary:
[  edit  ]
The Capture Region  SOP  defines capture region (cregion), which is a type of primitive which can be thought of as a modified tube primitive (a tube with half a sphere on either end). The hemispheres on the ends of the tubes are called "caps". Like any other primitive, each Capture Region has a primitive number and can be assigned primitive attributes. A Capture Region is simply a volume which is used to define the point capture weighting for a geometry. It is then animated to deform the geometry.
Capture Regions are always shown in wireframe (even in shaded mode) so that you can focus on the geometry for which the region will act on.

parameters.label: Orientation
parameters.name: orient
parameters.description: ⊞  - Defines the direction axis of the region. Use Z axis when the region is inside a bone object.

parameters.label: Center
parameters.name: t
parameters.description: ⊞  - Position of the center of the region.

parameters.label: Top Height
parameters.name: theight
parameters.description: Height of the region from the centre to the top cap.

parameters.label: Top Cap
parameters.name: tcap
parameters.description: ⊞  - The X, Y, Z radii of the top/bottom hemisphere.

parameters.label: Bottom Height
parameters.name: bheight
parameters.description: Height of the region from the centre to the top cap.

parameters.label: Bottom Cap
parameters.name: bcap
parameters.description: ⊞  - The X, Y, Z radii of the top/bottom hemisphere.

parameters.label: Max/Min Weight
parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: ⊞  - Defines the weight of a point exactly on the centre line and edge of the region respectively. Point weights in-between are blended.

parameters.label: Display Color
parameters.name: color
parameters.description: ⊞  - The Capture Region  SOP <uses region colors for helpful feedback.

parameters.label: Weighting is based on distance to the center line of the region. The center line's length is the height of the tube and runs down its center. When viewed in cross
parameters.description: section, the distance is measured perpendicular to the center line for the tube section and radially for the hemisphere region. This scheme is shown below. The lines represent the distance of points along the edge of the region.

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
